concepts.title: Instrument Setup
concepts.summary: Hold the violin and bow safely with a balanced, relaxed posture.

concepts.title: Bow Hold
concepts.summary: Shape the right hand around the bow with flexible fingers and thumb.

concepts.title: Left-Hand Frame
concepts.summary: Place the left hand and fingers over the fingerboard without squeezing.

concepts.title: Open-String Bow
concepts.summary: Draw a straight, steady bow across an open string.

concepts.title: First-Position Notes
concepts.summary: Place first-position fingers accurately on the fingerboard.

concepts.title: Steady Bowing
concepts.summary: Maintain consistent bow contact and rhythm across a short phrase.

concepts.title: Intonation Basics
concepts.summary: Listen for and correct pitch placement in first-position notes.

concepts.title: Simple Violin Melody
concepts.summary: Perform a short melody by combining bow control, fingering, and pitch.

edges.rationale: A safe balanced setup precedes the bow hold.
Left-hand placement depends on a stable instrument position.
The open-string bow exercise teaches the hold in motion.
Finger placement requires the left-hand frame.
Steady bowing develops from open-string control.
Pitch correction requires known first-position notes.
The melody requires consistent bow motion.
The melody requires reliable pitch placement.
